title: More candidates, fewer criteria
hook: Two stated cases: explore the computation saved by using fewer attributes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the computation saved by using fewer attributes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Checks, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the computation saved by using fewer attributes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Decision cost depends on both the number of options and the dimensions compared. A smaller interface can change this cost without removing alternatives. This comparison isolates the computation saved by using fewer attributes.
